_comment: Deterministic drops applied BEFORE any model call. Every row killed here is saved spend. Patterns are matched case-insensitively against '<title> <employer_name>'.
_evidence: The 2026-08-04 PoC confirmed the vet noise is real for 'dental receptionist' and 'medical assistant': Alliance Animal Health, American Veterinary Group, Animal Hospital of Dunedin, Ethos Veterinary Health. Extend this list as ambiguous terms surface new industries (ADR known issue 1).

sources._comment: Indeed is ~15x faster than LinkedIn and carries structured salary on ~44% of rows; LinkedIn overlaps by only ~5% at the employer level, so it roughly doubles reachable supply. They rotate separately — see design doc §6. Disabling one degrades the pipeline rather than halting it (ADR-02).

options._comment: include_confidential resolves design doc §11.3. ~12% of Indeed postings carry no employer name. They can still be qualified on role and location, and the posting URL is workable, so v1 SURFACES them — flagged in the UI rather than suppressed. Flip to false to suppress at collection time.
options._description_note: The prototype truncated descriptions to 600 chars, which discarded EHR/PMS mentions (only 1% of postings named a system — almost certainly a truncation artifact). Raised to 2000 here for storage; the qualifier still sees a short excerpt.
